_comment: TEMPORARY skin list until the team picks the final skins: ids must match the game's characters (client/ui/widgets/characters.gd, art in client/assets/characters/<id>/). The sprout is the free default and is not listed. Unlocked by the daily scan streak. Read by the photo service (ecoverify/) and the game server (set_skin). Edit this file to change skins; no code names them. A skin with "price" (and no "streak") is bought in the shop with scan points.
